synopsis:
Under Morosa's guidance, Luo Feng ventured deeper into the Boundary Beast's lair. In the darkness, his divine power was devoured, and Morosa was hunted for betraying his clan. Luo Feng repelled the encirclement with the Star Tower defense, the Wings of Wu Assassination Blockade, the Golden Claw God for close combat, and the Lie Yuan Technique for suppression. He witnessed the cruel mechanism of the beast devouring evolution—in the end, only a single king would be born. The outer defense lines of the universe were attacked, forcing the humans, crystals, and other races to jointly defend the small universe, while Hong, Thunder God, and Xu Xin stabilized Earth's rear. 

King candidate Bedi appears, stronger and more skilled at manipulating his own kind, mocking Morosa for bowing to "food" and trying to devour it. Luo Feng and Bedi fought head-on, saved Morosa, and promised not to abandon him, causing Luo Feng to shake his devouring instincts for the first time. Bedi commanded the beast horde to launch a final encirclement. Luo Feng changed tactics during extreme exhaustion: Morosa actively distracted the beasts and disrupted Bedi's rhythm. After being severely wounded, Bedi forcibly evolved. Morosa suggested devouring the remnants of his origin himself, and Luo Feng restrained him with the Lieyuan Art and the Bond Mark. Luo Feng suppressed Bedi's origin, and Morosa won the primordial battle in the Storm of Destruction. 

With Bedi's fall and the end of the realm beast calamity, Morosa became the only special realm beast under Luo Feng's command. After the battle, Luo Feng realized that this victory relied on higher civilization legacies such as the Star Tower, Jin World, and Lieyuan Technique. Morosa also sensed that the source of destruction lay far behind. Zuoshanke revealed: All three originate from the Origin Continent, where more complete rules exist, as well as the causality between the Jin and Food Kingdoms. Luo Feng understood that going to the Origin Continent was not about leaving home, but about seeking a true way to protect the human race and the Cosmic Sea. After bidding farewell to Xu Xin, Hong, and Thunder God, he took the Star Tower and Morosa into the Reincarnation Passage, heading to the Origin Continent. 

(Source: Tencent, translated)
